Please note, this competition does not include 3x3. If you are interested in competing in 3x3 we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.


This will be allocated on a first-come-first serve basis in order of payment.
